response.explanation: At line 10, src/presentation/app.ts imports the `Gateways` type and the `createGateways` factory from src/persistence/gateways.ts. It uses them in three places. `createApp` takes `gateways: Gateways = createGateways()` as a default parameter (line 16). `buildApp` declares `gateways: Gateways` in its public signature (line 20). That value is then passed straight into `new WeatherService(repos, gateways)` (line 28). This makes the presentation module the composition root for persistence-level external gateways: it builds and types persistence objects itself instead of getting everything through the business layer. FF-S03 flags this because a presentation-layer file depends directly on the persistence layer and skips the business layer between them. Presentation code is then tied to how persistence is built and what its types look like, so a change to the gateway API reaches the HTTP layer. Line 11 has the same pattern with `createRepositories` from ../persistence/repositories, which suggests the whole wiring of services, repositories and gateways sits in app.ts. None of the supplied docs, ADRs or comments say this wiring is intended or allowed.
